title: AI maturity teaser, Databricks pattern, WireGuard control planes, guarded AIOps
summary: Four Ed-selected topics: classical ML did not die — enterprise AI’s center of gravity shifted toward entities, relationships, and governed meaning (public teaser); Databricks’ Metric Views → Genie Ontology → coworkers story as a reference future pattern (not a buy-Databricks pitch); NetBird vs Defguard vs Headscale for WireGuard control planes (NetBird first for Authentik + Coolify); guarded AIOps as closing the loop with human gates — not unsupervised self-heal. Overheard: Salesforce/Nvidia Koa, Anthropic kill switches, OpenAI Glass Imaging, Ollama, Grab LLM-Kit.

sections.heading: AI maturity: classical ML → ontology & relationships (teaser)
bullets: Nuanced thesis: classical ML did not die — tree ensembles and anomaly scores still win many needle-in-haystack jobs. What shifted is ambition: from feature-table scoring to entities, relationships, and governed meaning GenAI can be held accountable to.

Two buyer pains (public frame): old AI — score dashboards when investigators need join paths across silos; new AI — copilots / naive RAG without shared vocabulary → hallucinations, wrong grain, PoC purgatory.
Mid-market glance: steep enterprise ontology platforms vs shallow auto-GraphRAG — the gap is relationship literacy and ontology-lite practices, not another horizontal “AI platform.”
Free takeaway: keep classical ML where scores beat explanations; invest meaning/relationships where multi-hop GenAI fails — not “replace all ML with graphs.”
Paywall: Digest stays teaser-only. Starter Pack (primer, checklist, scorecard) and deeper guides live on https://secure.efortune.tech — members only.

sections.heading: Databricks ontology-future pattern — teaser only
bullets: Market-direction story (not a SKU pitch): put governed meaning at the data layer, then use a living context graph so AI coworkers inherit governance — semantics upstream, agents downstream.

Pattern in one line: human-modeled metrics/definitions → inferred context with authority and permissions → coworkers/agents on that unified context (Databricks names this Metric Views / Genie Ontology / Genie One).
Why it fits dual-stack: that pattern grounds agents; it does not replace classical ML scores.
Mid-market note: teach the pattern without requiring a Lakehouse — Fabric, Bedrock GraphRAG, and Palantir are parallel futures; buyers still need ontology-lite packaging.
Paywall: full companion chapter (constitution / living graph / coworkers translations) is on Secure — not Digest.

sections.heading: NetBird vs Defguard vs Headscale (WireGuard control planes)
bullets: NetBird: own clients + control plane; P2P WireGuard with Signal/Relay fallback; mesh + routing peers/exit nodes; first-class Authentik OIDC; Coolify ships netbird-client one-click (not the server).
Headscale: self-hosted Tailscale-compatible control server + official Tailscale clients; Authentik/OIDC supported; documented limit — OIDC groups cannot drive ACLs; lean ops.
Defguard: hub-and-spoke gateway VPN + IAM; native connect-time WireGuard MFA; external OIDC/Authentik is Business-tier — not any-to-any mesh.
Snapshot: NetBird wins mesh + IdP fit; Headscale wins Tailscale-client familiarity + sovereignty with ACL caveats; Defguard wins gateway + connect-time MFA when hub-spoke is the model.
Recommendation for Authentik + Coolify: 1) NetBird 2) Headscale 3) Defguard only if connect-time MFA / gateway model outweighs mesh.

sections.heading: Guarded AIOps — teaser only
bullets: Public frame: the observability frontier is closing the loop from signal to explanation to guarded action — not unsupervised self-heal of unknown unknowns.
Durable bet (names only): assisted investigation, human/policy-gated remediation, and progressive delivery rollback — real before “fully autonomous ops.”
Concrete public anchors: OpenTelemetry Profiles public Alpha (experiment, not critical path); progressive delivery Analysis already rolls back without GenAI risk.
